title: Solve a quadratic by factorising
subject: Maths
body: A quadratic looks like x² + bx + c = 0. To factorise it, find two numbers that multiply to c and add to b.
Example: x² − 5x + 6 = 0. Two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to −5 are −2 and −3.
So the equation becomes (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0. Either x − 2 = 0 or x − 3 = 0, so x = 2 or x = 3.
Check: put x = 2 in the equation. 4 − 10 + 6 = 0, so it works.
Common mistake: writing the brackets with the wrong signs. Always expand the brackets to check.

title: Active recall in 10 minutes
subject: Study habits
body: Rereading feels easy but remembers little. Testing yourself works better.
Step 1: read one small section for 5 minutes.
Step 2: close the book and write everything you remember, for 3 minutes.
Step 3: open the book and mark what you missed, for 2 minutes.
Repeat the same section after 1 day, 3 days and 1 week. The gaps get smaller each time.

title: A 4-minute calm reset before you study
subject: Stress
body: Sit with both feet on the floor and put your phone away.
Breathe in through your nose for 4 counts and out slowly for 6 counts. Do this for 2 minutes.
Look around and name 3 things you can see. This brings your mind back to the room.
Write down the one next task, such as 'solve 5 questions of Chapter 3', and work on it for 10 minutes.
If the worry stays heavy for days, talk to a teacher, parent or counsellor. In India, Tele-MANAS (14416) is free and open 24x7.
